_source: DOMINION slice D13, the Debate offline (plans/evil-mode-rework Part 4 §3, Part 9 A2-A4 and A6; Part 0 §6.1 Q2: offline first, set lines with fixed scores). Lines, replies and demands written for D13 from each Boss's canon values (Part 4 §3.2).

rounds.name: Values
rounds.what: What each of you thinks the world should be

rounds.name: Methods
rounds.what: How you each work, and what you won't do

rounds.name: The Future
rounds.what: What their team becomes under you

marks.name: Values
marks.what: Speaking to what they care about

marks.name: Respect
marks.what: Arguing with them, not at them

marks.name: Honesty
marks.what: Not bluffing about what the game knows

results.name: Convinced
results.text: A Merger or a loyal Branch: your choice. Betrayal risk halved.

results.name: Persuaded, on conditions
results.text: A Branch, with one demand. Breaking it: betrayal risk +25 and the Branch may walk.

results.name: Unmoved
results.text: Nothing changes. Tension −10: they respect that you came.

results.name: Offended
results.text: Tension +15. Only a forced takeover is left.

stances.name: Merger
stances.aims: Aims at a Merger. −5 unless you're stronger

stances.name: Threaten
stances.aims: Fast, scores low. −5 unless your Dread is twice their Fear

lines.text: You won't kneel. You'll own half of what I build. {team} keeps the old money afraid; my crew keeps the streets.
We split the region down the middle. Your rackets stay yours, mine stay mine, and the police chase shadows.
My crew already runs more towns than you think. Stand with us now, while it's still a partnership.
One team, one name, one ledger. Your people get paid more than you ever paid them.
Fold {team} into mine and you keep your Admins, your old HQ and a seat at my table.
I have the numbers now. Merge, and nobody on either side has to bleed for it.
You're wasted on {team}, {boss}. Come and run my operations as my right hand.
Your team is a weight on your back. Put it down and work for me; I'll give you the work you deserve.
I've never robbed a family or a shop. Join a team whose hands are clean.
Your people already lose to mine. Join me before there's nothing left of {team} to join.
I can burn every site {team} has by Sunday. Kneel, or watch.
You're old news, {boss}. Step aside or be stepped on.

towns.callout: {boss} laughs. "You hold {towns} town{s}. Don't sell me a map you haven't coloured in."

rich.callout: {boss} raises an eyebrow. "₽{funds}? That isn't a war chest, it's a wallet."

army.callout: {boss} counts on their fingers. "You have {members} people. I've met bigger picnics."

clean.callout: {boss} slides a page across the table. "{sin}. Clean hands, you said?"

strong.what: you've beaten one of their Admins or their Boss
strong.callout: {boss} doesn't blink. "Mine lose to you? Name one. You can't."

sins.text: You stopped a cash transport on the open road
You pulled a heist by moonlight
You lifted wallets in a crowd
You emptied a Pokémon Center donation box
You put up the rent on working families
You broke into a closed shop
You smashed a shop window and ran
You grabbed a trader's goods in broad daylight
You leaned on a shopkeeper for "protection"
You collected a dead man's debts
You ambushed a route trainer for their prize money

demands.broken: You moved in on {town}, a town you promised them.

demands.text: Never touch their old HQ in {town}
demands.broken: You pushed into {town}, around their old HQ.

demands.note: Kept until Goals arrive (D14): nothing can break it yet.
Kept until Shadow Pokémon arrive (D16): nothing can break it yet.

directives.name: Expand
directives.what: New rackets in a weak town: +{n} Control a night in your weakest town

directives.name: Defend
directives.what: Guards up: HQ Heat −{n} a night

directives.name: Recruit
directives.what: +{n} members to the Branch at the week's end (more tribute)

directives.name: Pressure the Hero
directives.what: Delays the Hero a day a week
directives.note: Counted now; the Hero (D11) reads it.

directives.name: Hold a town
directives.what: Your best town can't lose Control this week

rocket.creed: Power is the only honest currency. Rocket earns it, keeps it, and answers to nobody. What do you answer to?
rocket.judge: {sin}. Is that your 'order'? Even Rocket counts what it takes.
rocket.clean: Your Ledger is spotless. Either you're careful, or you've done nothing worth writing down.
rocket.price: Rocket kneels to nobody for free. Silph stays mine, and so does the Game Corner. What's left, you can rule.

strong: Hm. You understand money. That's rarer than courage.
Now you're speaking my language. Go on.
A real offer. Rocket remembers those.
fair: I've heard that pitch before, from better tailors.
weak: You came all this way to say that?
Try again, and this time bring numbers.
insult: Careful. My Persian has better manners than you.
Threats, at my own table? How small.

rocket-remnants.creed: Rocket isn't finished. It's waiting for its Boss to come home. Are you here to help, or to take his chair?
rocket-remnants.judge: {sin}. Giovanni would never have been that clumsy.
rocket-remnants.clean: No mess on your Ledger. Giovanni liked tidy people.
rocket-remnants.price: The radio tower stays ours, and the day Giovanni calls, we answer him first.

strong: You talk like him, a little.
That would keep the lights on until he returns.
fair: Maybe. The others won't like it.
You're not him. But you're not nothing.
weak: That's not how Rocket does things.
You don't understand what we're waiting for.
insult: Giovanni would have had you thrown out.
We've been threatened by better.

magma.creed: People need ground to stand on. Magma will give them more of it, sea or no sea. Where do you stand?
magma.clean: Your Ledger builds more than it breaks. I noticed.
magma.price: Mt. Chimney stays Magma's, and every new shore we raise is ours to settle.

strong: Now that is a plan with a foundation.
fair: Close, but the numbers don't settle.
There's ground in that. Not much.
insult: Threats are what people use when they have no plan.
I don't negotiate with tremors.

aqua.creed: The sea was here first, and so were the Pokémon in it. Aqua stands with them. Who do you stand with?
aqua.price: The coast stays ours, start to finish. Touch the water and the deal sinks.

strong: Ha! Now that's a proper offer!
You've got salt in you after all.
Aye, that I can drink to.
weak: You're all talk and no boat.
insult: Say that again and you'll swim home.
Big words from someone this far from the sea.

galactic.creed: Spirit is noise. Galactic will build a world without it, quiet and complete. Why should noise like you join?
galactic.clean: Your record is orderly. That is the only compliment I give.
galactic.price: Spear Pillar is Galactic's. My work continues, and no one interrupts it.

weak: That is a feeling, not an argument.
insult: Anger. How predictable.
You are wasting my time.

plasma.creed: Plasma frees Pokémon from people. Or so the crowds believe. Tell me what you'd free, and who would hold the key.
plasma.clean: No witnesses on your Ledger. You learn quickly.
plasma.price: The castle stays mine, and Plasma's banners keep flying in every town you take.

strong: Ah. You understand how the world really works.
weak: The crowds would see through that.
insult: You threaten me? How liberating.
Bluster. Plasma has buried louder men.

flare.creed: The world is ugly because it is crowded. Flare will keep only what is beautiful. Are you beautiful?
flare.price: Lumiose's best streets stay ours, and Flare chooses who may walk them.

insult: Crude. And in that coat.
Threats are so unfashionable.

skull-aether.values: a home for the ones nobody wants
skull-aether.creed: Skull takes in the kids nobody wanted. Bet you never got turned away from anything. Prove me wrong.
skull-aether.judge: {sin}. Ha. You're one of us after all.
skull-aether.clean: Squeaky clean, huh? Bet nobody ever slammed a door on you.
skull-aether.price: Po Town stays Skull's. Nobody touches my kids, and I don't take orders in front of them.

insult: Ha! At least you got guts.
You wanna go? 'Cause we can go.

macro-cosmos.creed: Galar will need energy for a thousand years. I plan for that. What are you planning for, next Tuesday?
macro-cosmos.judge: {sin}. Short-term thinking. Terrible for the brand.
macro-cosmos.clean: Your record would pass an audit. Impressive.
macro-cosmos.price: The towers stay Macro Cosmos property, and our name goes on the door beside yours.

strong: Splendid! That's a proposal I could take to the board.
fair: Promising, but the margins are thin.
Let's call it a first draft.
insult: Threats are terribly bad for business.
I'll pretend I didn't hear that.

area-zero.values: a past or future without limits
area-zero.creed: The crater holds a world without limits. Research needs no team, only time. Why should it need yours?
area-zero.price: The Zero Lab stays sealed and mine. You may have everything above the crater.

insult: Hostility noted.
Threat logged. It changes nothing.

admin.creed: {boss} gave me a place when nobody else would. What would you give me?
admin.price: If I leave {team}, I need to know I won't be hunted. And I want my own crew.

weak: That's it? I'll stay where I am.
insult: You think I scare easy?
{boss} will hear about this.

text.noTeam: No rival Boss to talk to.
text.closed: {boss} will never talk to you again this region.
text.week: One Debate with {boss} a week. Try again next week.
text.needBeat: {boss} won't meet a nobody: beat one of their Admins first (answer a challenge on the Rival File).
text.meet: {boss} agrees to sit down at the Leader's Table.
text.walkOut: You walk out on {boss}. It counts as a failed Debate.
text.inviteBoss: {boss} will sit down for a Debate at neutral ground.
text.merger: {team} folds into yours. {joined}Their sites are yours.
text.branch: {team} becomes your Branch. It pays {tribute} a week and takes an order every Monday (Rival File).
text.walked: {team} walks out of the deal. Tension is back to {tension}.
text.noRoom: No room at the HQ for {names}: they stay to run the old sites.
